name: Chihayaakasaka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Chihayaakasaka village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised tower-like pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Chihayaakasaka, a village in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1966.

features.role: Chihayaakasaka village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised tower-like pointed device
